title: Associate ML Engineer
jd:
Associate ML Engineer (0-2 years), Northwind Analytics, Bengaluru
We are hiring early-career engineers to build and ship machine learning features.

What you will do
- Train, evaluate and iterate on ML models for ranking and classification.
- Build data pipelines and feature tables in SQL and Python.
- Write clean, tested code and document experiments.

Required
- Strong Python and ML fundamentals (scikit-learn or PyTorch).
- At least one end-to-end ML project, academic or personal, not a cloned tutorial.
- Working SQL.
- Understanding of model evaluation metrics (precision, recall, AUC) and train/validation splits.

Good to have
- Docker or any cloud platform.
- Experience with LLMs or retrieval (RAG).
- Exposure to MLOps tooling (MLflow, experiment tracking).
resume:
Test Candidate A
EDUCATION
B.Tech Computer Science, 2026, CGPA 8.4/10. Coursework: Machine Learning, Statistics, Databases, Data Structures.
EXPERIENCE
ML Intern, Summer 2025 (3 months), a retail analytics startup
- Built a pandas and SQL pipeline that produced weekly feature tables for a churn model.
- Trained an XGBoost churn classifier, reaching AUC 0.81 on a held-out month; compared against a logistic regression baseline.
PROJECTS
Document question answering with RAG: sentence embeddings plus cosine retrieval served through FastAPI, evaluated with recall@5 on 200 hand-labelled questions.
Sentiment classifier: fine-tuned DistilBERT on 20k reviews in PyTorch, reported precision, recall and F1 per class.
SKILLS
Python, SQL, scikit-learn, PyTorch, pandas, FastAPI, Docker, Git
note: Fresher with evidence for every required item. Expect Apply.
